tasks.name: 文本过滤
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ====== 内置占位符过滤 开关 ======
(async () => {
    // 跑一次切换状态；显示"原状态 → 新状态"
    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/vector/utils/text-filter.js');
    const wasEnabled = mod.isFilterBuiltinPlaceholdersEnabled();
    const next = mod.toggleFilterBuiltinPlaceholders();
    const label = (b) => (b ? '开启' : '关闭');
    window.toastr?.success(`内置占位符过滤：${label(wasEnabled)} → ${label(next)}`);
})();
<</taskjs>>
